blocks.efield:celestialaegis.tooltip.details: Deflects incoming projectiles with 2.0 push strength. Costs 16k FE per hit and 90 FE/t while active. Hold an iron ingot to preview the shield.
blocks.efield:comgrafield.tooltip.details: One-way defensive shield. Only deflects projectiles moving toward the center. Default push strength is 2.0, with 16k FE per hit and 90 FE/t upkeep. Hold an iron ingot to preview the shield.
blocks.efield:efield.tooltip.details: Deflects incoming projectiles with 1.5 push strength. Costs 8k FE per hit. Hold an iron ingot to preview the shield.
blocks.efield:kleinfield.tooltip: Forward 9x9x9 defensive wall. External charging only fills it to half capacity.
blocks.efield:kleinfield.tooltip.details: Deletes incoming projectiles, converts twice the interception cost into stored heat, shuts down when full, and bleeds heat above half capacity. Hold an iron ingot to preview the green range.
blocks.efield:nemerepairsystem.tooltip: Empty-hand right-click to configure and save a repair blueprint.
blocks.efield:nemerepairsystem.tooltip.details: Repairs one missing air block per scan from neighboring containers. Copycat block entity data is preserved. Redstone disables it.
blocks.efield:regenerativehullcore.tooltip: Empty-hand right-click to configure the stocked repair area.
blocks.efield:regenerativehullcore.tooltip.deta: Stores 9 stacks, accepts item pipes, and fills one air block in front of it per scan using stored FE.
blocks.efield:voidproxy.tooltip: Default radius = 8. Empty-hand right-click to set radius from 8 to 32.
blocks.efield:voidproxy.tooltip.details: One-way spherical shield. Deletes incoming projectiles. Cost = speed * radius * coefficient. Hold an iron ingot to preview the purple range.
